name: component-catalog
description: /components lists your existing UI components so Claude reuses them instead of creating duplicates.

componentDirs.title: Component folders
componentDirs.description: Comma-separated folders (from the project root) scanned for components.
componentDirs.default: components, src/components, ui, src/ui, app/components, src/app/components, src/lib/components, lib/components

promptChars.title: Prompt section size
promptChars.description: Most characters of the component list added to Claude's system prompt (0 turns the section off).

warnSimilar.title: Warn about near-duplicates
warnSimilar.description: When Claude writes a new component whose name is close to an existing one, tell it (and you).
